mapper.select: SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.DEPTH, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ROLE_GROUP FROM tb_user_menu tum JOIN tb_menu_role tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE tr.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND DEPTH = 1 AND tum.USE_ADMIN = 'Y' ORDER BY tum.MENU_CODE

SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.DEPTH, tum.PARENT_CODE, tum.PATH, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ROLE_GROUP FROM TB_USER_MENU tum JOIN TB_MENU_ROLE tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE PARENT_CODE IN (SELECT tum.MENU_CODE FROM TB_USER_MENU tum JOIN TB_MENU_ROLE tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr on tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE DEPTH = 1) AND tr.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND tum.USE_ADMIN = 'Y' ORDER BY tum.MENU_CODE
SELECT BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET, INSERT_DT FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD ORDER BY INSERT_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMON_BOARD ( BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{boardCode}, #{boardNm}, #{useAnswer}, #{useComment}, #{useNotice}, #{useSecret}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_CODE FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD WHERE BOARD_CODE LIKE 'BOARD_%' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(board_code, 7) AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
SELECT tbr.BOARD_CODE, tbr.ROLE_CODE, tbr.BOARDROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM FROM TB_BOARD_ROLE tbr INNER JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tbr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMON_BOARD SET BOARD_NM = #{boardNm}, USE_ANSWER = #{useAnswer}, USE_COMMENT = #{useComment}, USE_NOTICE = #{useNotice}, USE_SECRET = #{useSecret} WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
